newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Severe quake recorded in vicinity of Solomons.
newsitem.headline: Severe quake recorded in vicinity of Solomons.

text.p: A severe earthquake estimated at 7.0 on the Richter scale was recorded in the vicinity of Solomon islands early on Tuesday, Hong Kong's Royal Observatory said.
The observatory said it determined the epicentre of the quake at about 560 km (350 miles) west-northwest of Honiara, the capital.
There were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.
The Solomons are an island chain in the western Pacific Ocean north-east of Australia.
